territories.name: Burundi
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Burundi levies a value added tax of its own under Loi n°1/12 du 29 juillet 2013 portant révision de la loi n°1/02 du 17 février 2009, as amended by Loi n°1/10 du 16 novembre 2020: article 19 sets it at 18 per cent with an intermediate rate of 10 per cent and a zero rate for exports, article 10 exempts the operations it lists, and article 52 has the taxpayer file the return by the 15th of the month following.
